    The dimension difference of a linear map #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.finrank_sub_eq_ker_sub_dualKer {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [Field k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [Module.Finite k V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] [Module.Finite k W] (f : V →ₗ[k] W) :
    ↑(Module.finrank k V) - ↑(Module.finrank k W) = ↑(Module.finrank k ↥f.ker) - ↑(Module.finrank k ↥f.dualMap.ker)

    The difference between the dimensions of the source and target is the difference between the dimensions of the kernel and of the dual kernel.
